msg: There are two groups of gnomes based on their colours: High value gnomes and Low Value Gnomes. The points for each gnome range from 0-9 mushrooms. After a while the high value gnomes will start to deplete in value and the low value gnomes will start to gain in value. The time to lower and gain value will shorten as the rounds progress. The groupings seem to be as follows: Group 1 - Red, Blue, Pink & Purple. Group 2 - Brown, Yellow, Green and Orange.For example: If Red was providing a high number of mushrooms, Blue, Pink and Purple will also provide a high number.
